episodes.207510: A line of showers and thunderstorms moved across Middle Tennessee during the afternoon and evening of November 7, 2025. With warm, moist air ahead of a cold front along with abundant wind shear, this environment allowed for damaging wind gusts along the leading edge of the thunderstorms. Several reports of downed trees were received along with a few reports of hail up the size of quarters. With waning instability, these thunderstorms weakened as they got east of Nashville and closer to the Cumberland Plateau.
episodes.208764: Scattered thunderstorms developed along a cold front as it pushed through the Tennessee River into Middle Tennessee. Enough instability and shear were present to support a few severe storms from near the Tennessee River eastward into Middle Tennessee. Some wind damage occurred in Benton County.

events.narrative: A brief microburst caused damage to tree limbs, uprooted a tree, and damaged a barn along Cedar Grove Road and Holland Road. Small hail also occurred.
Severe thunderstorm winds downed a tree onto a house on W 1st Street in Dickson. Damages are a rough estimate.
Severe thunderstorm winds downed numerous trees across Montgomery Bell State Park near Burns. Some roads were reportedly closed. Damages are a rough estimate.
Estimated quarter size hail was reported southeast of Pegram.
Estimated quarter size hail was reported west of Forest Hills.
Estimated 60 mph winds were reported in the Bellevue area by multiple broadcast meteorologists and storm chasers. A few trees were reported down in the area. Damages are a rough estimate.
Severe thunderstorm winds downed trees near Highway 431 southeast of Bellevue. Damages are a rough estimate.

Severe thunderstorm winds broke or uprooted about eight to ten trees in the area of Chapel Court and Brookside Drive in Franklin. One home had minor tree where a tree fell on it and broke the wooden structure of the soffit. Damages are a rough estimate.
Severe thunderstorm winds downed a tree onto a home on Arrowhead Drive in Brentwood. Damages are a rough estimate.
